metrics.name: posting_floor_adherence
metrics.plain: Share of this week's planned posts that actually went out
metrics.unavailable_when: no calendar connected or no floor set
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, compares to the brand's own set floor

metrics.name: festive_slot_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of festivals in the next 30 days that already have a script assigned

metrics.name: founder_camera_share
metrics.plain: Share of published posts that feature the founder on camera
metrics.unavailable_when: posts are not tagged for on-camera presence

metrics.name: revenue_from_tagged_content
metrics.plain: Orders that came from a specific post, tracked by its own link tag or promo code
metrics.formula: sum(order_value) where session utm_content or promo code matches a post id, within its view-through window
metrics.source: store orders joined to analytics UTM/promo-code table
metrics.unavailable_when: the post's link carries no UTM tag or promo code

metrics.name: content_pillar_revenue_share
metrics.plain: Share of tagged content revenue coming from each pillar
metrics.formula: revenue_from_tagged_content grouped by pillar / total tagged revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 tagged orders in the window

metrics.name: link_destination_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of live posts whose link opens a working page that matches the post
metrics.window: checked daily on all posts from the last 90 days
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without a check

metrics.name: shoppable_tag_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of eligible posts with correct product tags attached
metrics.source: platform catalog tagging API + calendar plan

metrics.name: comment_response_time_median
metrics.plain: Typical time to the first reply on a comment or DM that needs one
metrics.formula: median(first_reply_time - message_time) for messages flagged as needing a reply
metrics.benchmark: under 1 hour on the hero platform

metrics.name: dm_to_owned_contact_rate
metrics.plain: Share of DM conversations that end with an email, WhatsApp opt-in or phone number captured
metrics.unavailable_when: no DM funnel or CRM link

metrics.name: ugc_pipeline_depth
metrics.plain: Verified reviews and UGC assets ready to post, by SKU
metrics.formula: count(verified_ugc_assets) where posted = false, grouped by sku
metrics.freshness_rule: recomputed on each new review import

metrics.name: asset_reuse_rate
metrics.plain: Share of assets past their reuse checkpoint that got reused on at least one other surface
metrics.unavailable_when: assets are not tagged with a shelf-life date

metrics.name: creator_seeding_active_count
metrics.plain: Creators currently seeded with product this month, and total product cost sent
metrics.formula: count(distinct creator) and sum(product_cost) where seeding_status = active

metrics.name: creator_content_yield
metrics.plain: Content pieces delivered per 10 creators seeded
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 creators seeded in the window

metrics.name: claims_gate_hold_count
metrics.plain: Posts the safety gate held before publish this month, and the most common rule triggered
metrics.formula: count(posts) where gate_result = held, grouped by rule
metrics.unavailable_when: claims gate not running on this account

metrics.name: stranger_blind_share
metrics.plain: Share of the top 10 posts by reach that name no product and give no next step
metrics.unavailable_when: posts are not tagged for SKU or CTA

metrics.name: broad_low_value_hit_share
metrics.plain: Share of top-quartile-reach posts whose matched orders fall below the brand's set floor
metrics.formula: count(top_quartile_reach posts where matched_orders < floor) / count(top_quartile_reach posts)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 10 posts in the top quartile

metrics.name: youtube_search_traffic_share
metrics.plain: Share of channel views coming from YouTube search rather than suggested or browse

metrics.name: community_active_member_rate
metrics.plain: Share of community members who sent at least one message in the last 30 days

metrics.name: community_to_order_rate
metrics.plain: Share of community members who also placed an order in the same window, matched by phone or email
metrics.source: community roster matched to orders (phone match for WhatsApp)
metrics.unavailable_when: roster cannot be matched to orders (no shared phone/email field)

insights.name: posting floor missed
insights.rule: posts_published this week < posts_planned at floor
insights.sentence: {n} of {planned} planned posts did not go out this week
insights.severity: high if 2+ weeks running, else medium

insights.name: festive gap
insights.rule: a festival is within 14 days and has zero assigned script
insights.sentence: {festival} is in {d} days and has no script yet

insights.name: stranger-blind viral post
insights.rule: a post is in the top 3 by reach in the last 30 days and carries no named SKU or CTA tag
insights.sentence: {title} got {reach} views but named no product and gave no next step

insights.name: broad low-value hit
insights.rule: a post is in the top reach quartile and its matched orders fall below the set floor
insights.sentence: {title} reached {n} people but sold {k} pieces, below the {floor} floor

insights.name: unused UGC
insights.rule: a verified review or photo asset has sat unposted for more than 21 days
insights.sentence: {n} verified reviews are unused for over {d} days

insights.name: asset expiring unused
insights.rule: an asset's shelf-life end date is within 7 days and its reuse count is 0
insights.sentence: {n} assets retire this week without being reused anywhere

insights.name: claims gate catching a real pattern
insights.rule: the same claims rule triggers 3 or more times in a month
insights.sentence: {n} posts were held this month for {top_rule}, more than any other rule

insights.name: creator seeding, no yield
insights.rule: a creator was seeded more than 21 days ago and has delivered zero content
insights.sentence: {n} of {seeded} creators sent product but delivered nothing in 3 weeks

insights.name: DM funnel leak
insights.rule: the share of DM threads ending with no captured contact exceeds 70%
insights.sentence: {pct}% of DM conversations end without an email, WhatsApp opt-in or phone number

insights.name: dead or mismatched link
insights.rule: a live post's link fails the check or does not match the intended page
insights.sentence: {n} live posts point to a page that is down or does not match

insights.name: comment response lag
insights.rule: a comment or DM needing a reply has waited more than 24 hours
insights.sentence: {n} messages have waited over {h} hours for a reply

insights.name: community going quiet
insights.rule: active member rate falls 10 percentage points or more month over month
insights.sentence: community activity fell {pct} points this month

insights.name: YouTube search share falling
insights.rule: search-traffic share this period is lower than the prior period
insights.sentence: {pct}% of views now come from search, down from {prev}%

insights.name: founder over budget
insights.rule: founder_camera_share exceeds the target set when the on-camera plan was made
insights.sentence: {pct}% of posts need the founder on camera, above the {target}% plan

visuals.name: calendar heatmap
visuals.shows: planned vs published posts per day, with festival flags
visuals.why_this_chart: founder sees the whole month's cadence and gaps at a glance

visuals.name: SKU by hook revenue grid
visuals.shows: matched revenue for each SKU by hook type
visuals.why_this_chart: shows exactly where content made money, not just where it got views

visuals.name: comment to order funnel
visuals.shows: comments to DMs to owned contacts to orders
visuals.why_this_chart: shows where the funnel actually leaks

visuals.name: creator seeding scorecard
visuals.shows: creators seeded, cost sent, content delivered, yield
visuals.why_this_chart: one view of whether seeding spend is producing usable content

visuals.name: asset lifecycle timeline
visuals.shows: shelf-life window and reuse events across PDP, email, DM and post-purchase
visuals.why_this_chart: shows what is about to expire unused before it happens

visuals.name: community health line
visuals.shows: weekly active member rate with matched-order rate overlaid
visuals.why_this_chart: ties community moderation effort to whether it is paying back

not_elsewhere.claim: ties each post to the order it produced, by SKU and hook, using the post's own link tag or promo code
not_elsewhere.vs: Metricool, Later, Hootsuite and Sprout Social show reach, engagement and (Hootsuite/Sprout) social listening, but none join a post to a matched order

not_elsewhere.claim: runs a fixed claims and safety gate against the brand's own claim tiers before a post can publish
not_elsewhere.vs: scheduler approval flows (Hootsuite, Sprout Social) check for human sign-off, not a rule-based claims-risk check

not_elsewhere.claim: tracks creator seeding cost, fulfillment and content yield against the same tagged asset library the calendar draws from
not_elsewhere.vs: creator/UGC platforms track shipments and creators, but do not connect yield to the brand's own content library or calendar

not_elsewhere.claim: flags a stranger-blind viral post and a broad-reach, low-order hit by a fixed rule tied to the store's own orders
not_elsewhere.vs: platform analytics report reach and engagement; none of the mainstream schedulers flag a post as viral-but-not-selling against the brand's own order floor

not_elsewhere.claim: tracks an asset's shelf life and reuse across PDP, email, DM and post-purchase flow before retiring it
not_elsewhere.vs: social schedulers manage the posting calendar only; they do not track reuse of the same asset across owned commerce surfaces

not_elsewhere.claim: reads the owned WhatsApp or Discord community's active-member rate against matched store orders
not_elsewhere.vs: Later has no social listening at all; Hootsuite and Sprout Social track engagement inside the platform, not matched to the brand's own order data

founder_view_note: With nothing connected yet, every metric shows unavailable and the room shows only the calendar plan and a checklist of what to connect (platform insights, UTM/promo tracking, the claims gate log, the seeding tracker, the community roster). The first thing that lands once platform insights connect is posting_floor_adherence and the calendar heatmap; revenue_from_tagged_content only appears once posts carry a UTM tag or promo code, which the room should prompt the team to add before the first campaign.

metrics.name: organic_sessions
metrics.plain: Visits that came from unpaid search
metrics.formula: GA4 sessions where default channel group = Organic Search

metrics.name: organic_revenue
metrics.plain: Store revenue from orders that started with an unpaid search visit
metrics.formula: sum(order_value) where first-touch session channel = organic search, joined by session id or converted client id
metrics.source: GA4 sessions joined to store orders

metrics.name: organic_revenue_share
metrics.plain: Share of total store revenue that organic search brought in

metrics.name: keyword_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of the buyer-question map that has a live page ranking in the top 20

metrics.name: page1_keyword_count
metrics.plain: Number of mapped keywords ranking in the top 10, and the change from last month
metrics.formula: count(keywords where rank <= 10), delta vs 30 days ago

metrics.name: ctr_by_query_group
metrics.plain: Click-through rate for branded vs non-branded search queries
metrics.formula: clicks / impressions, grouped by branded vs non-branded query classification
metrics.benchmark: non-branded CTR at position 1 typically 25 to 35%

metrics.name: indexed_page_ratio
metrics.plain: Share of submitted sitemap pages that Google has actually indexed
metrics.benchmark: over 95% for a catalog this size

metrics.name: crawl_error_count
metrics.plain: Pages returning a broken status, a bad redirect or a redirect chain, on the latest crawl
metrics.formula: count(pages) where status in (4xx, 5xx) or redirect_hops >= 3

metrics.name: orphan_page_count
metrics.plain: Pages with zero internal links pointing to them

metrics.name: schema_validation_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of product and collection pages with valid, error-free schema
metrics.source: structured-data validator run against money pages

metrics.name: content_refresh_backlog_value
metrics.plain: Total revenue-at-risk sitting in pages flagged for refresh, ranked
metrics.formula: sum(page_trailing_90d_revenue) for pages where clicks fell 20%+ over 90 days and not refreshed
metrics.source: GSC clicks history + organic_revenue by page

metrics.name: referring_domains_new
metrics.plain: New unique domains linking to the site this month
metrics.formula: count(distinct referring_domain) first seen this month

metrics.name: link_velocity_by_source
metrics.plain: New links split by tactic: PR, guest post, broken-link, review-site
metrics.unavailable_when: outreach tactic not tagged on the link

metrics.name: gbp_review_rate
metrics.plain: New Google Business Profile reviews this month and the average rating
metrics.unavailable_when: no physical location or GBP not connected

metrics.name: tag_health_score
metrics.plain: Share of key events (page view, add to cart, purchase) firing correctly on the last audit
metrics.window: monthly, checked on demand after any theme change
metrics.unavailable_when: no tag audit run this cycle

metrics.name: cwv_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of the top page templates passing Core Web Vitals
metrics.formula: templates_passing / templates_checked, using field or lab data

metrics.name: discontinued_page_handling_rate
metrics.plain: Share of out-of-stock or discontinued product pages that redirect properly instead of 404ing

insights.name: unexplained traffic drop
insights.rule: organic_sessions falls 15% or more week over week with no logged algorithm update or seasonal cause
insights.sentence: organic visits fell {pct}% this week with no known cause logged

insights.name: CTR mismatch
insights.rule: a page's impressions rank in the top 20% and its CTR sits 30% or more below the branded/non-branded benchmark for its position
insights.sentence: {page} gets {impressions} impressions but a CTR of only {ctr}%, well under what position {pos} should get

insights.name: keyword cannibalization
insights.rule: 2 or more pages rank for the same primary keyword within 5 positions of each other
insights.sentence: {n} pages compete for '{keyword}', splitting the ranking signal

insights.name: orphan money page
insights.rule: a page in the keyword map has zero internal inlinks
insights.sentence: {page} targets '{keyword}' but gets no internal links from anywhere on the site

insights.name: stale high-value page
insights.rule: a page in the top 20% of pages by organic_revenue has clicks down 20% or more over 90 days and has not been refreshed in 180 days
insights.sentence: {page} makes {revenue} a month but clicks fell {pct}% and it has not been touched in {days} days

insights.name: broken schema on a money page
insights.rule: a product or collection page's schema fails validation
insights.sentence: {n} product pages have broken {schema_type} schema

insights.name: long redirect chain
insights.rule: a URL has 3 or more redirect hops before landing
insights.sentence: {n} URLs take {hops} redirects to load, slowing crawl and the visitor

insights.name: discontinued page 404ing
insights.rule: an out-of-stock or discontinued product page returns a 404 or soft-404 instead of a redirect to a live alternative
insights.sentence: {n} discontinued product pages 404 instead of pointing buyers somewhere live

insights.name: outreach not landing links
insights.rule: 60 or more outreach pitches sent in 60 days produced zero new referring domains
insights.sentence: no new links from {n} pitches sent in the last {days} days

insights.name: unanswered reviews
insights.rule: a Google Business Profile review has gone unanswered for more than 7 days
insights.sentence: {n} reviews have waited over a week for a reply

insights.name: tag stopped firing
insights.rule: a key GA4 event's daily count drops to zero for 2 or more consecutive days
insights.sentence: the {event} tag stopped firing on {date}

insights.name: AI crawler blocked on a money page
insights.rule: robots.txt disallows a known AI crawler (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) on a page in the keyword map
insights.sentence: {n} money pages block {crawler} from reading them

insights.name: vendor claim does not hold up
insights.rule: a vendor-cited stat about the site differs from the brand's own analytics by 20% or more
insights.sentence: the vendor claims {vendor_stat} but our own data shows {actual_stat}

visuals.why_this_chart: shows which link-building tactic is actually working

not_elsewhere.vs: Search Console reports clicks, impressions, CTR and position only; GA4's channel reports do not reconcile to the store's own revenue number

not_elsewhere.claim: sequences the refresh backlog by revenue at risk from the store's own order data, ahead of writing anything new

not_elsewhere.claim: screens a vendor's own pitch numbers against the brand's own analytics before the founder signs anything
not_elsewhere.vs: no SEO platform performs vendor due diligence; every tool here assumes the brand already hired the vendor

jobs.job: run a fixed prompt set and see how each AI engine describes and recommends us
jobs.question: what does ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI say about us today

jobs.job: know whether an engine's answer is a real gap and how bad it is
jobs.question: which of the 6 gap types are we in for each named engine

jobs.job: publish one facts page that closes every gap the audit finds
jobs.question: what facts are missing that a buyer prompt keeps needing

jobs.job: keep the same facts identical everywhere an engine can read them
jobs.question: does the price, return window, warranty and COD answer match on the site, schema, feed and directories

jobs.job: make an existing high-value page easy for an engine to lift a direct answer from
jobs.question: which pages are citable and which still bury the answer

jobs.job: fix a wrong AI-stated fact at the source first, then the likely publisher
jobs.question: what is an engine getting wrong about us right now, and where did it likely learn it

jobs.job: know if a correction actually landed after fixing it
jobs.question: did the engine's answer change after we fixed it, and how long did that take

jobs.job: check what a shopping agent would tell a buyer about us right now
jobs.question: would an AI shopping agent get our price, stock and delivery estimate right

jobs.job: get a short weekly read on what changed for us and named competitors
jobs.question: did an engine change how it describes a named competitor, or did they make a new claim

metrics.name: ai_mention_rate
metrics.plain: Share of the frozen prompt set where the brand is mentioned at all, per engine
metrics.window: monthly, per engine (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode)
metrics.unavailable_when: the prompt set has not run this cycle for that engine

metrics.name: ai_recommend_rate
metrics.plain: Share of prompts where the brand is named as a recommended option, not just mentioned
metrics.unavailable_when: prompt set has not run this cycle

metrics.name: ai_share_of_voice
metrics.plain: Brand mentions as a share of all named-brand mentions (brand plus named competitors) in the same prompt set
metrics.unavailable_when: no competitor prompt runs to compare against

metrics.name: ai_sentiment_score
metrics.plain: Share of brand mentions classified positive under a fixed rubric

metrics.name: fact_gap_count
metrics.plain: Gaps found in the last prompt audit, by category (price, materials, returns, shipping, COD, warranty)
metrics.formula: count(gaps) from the last audit, grouped by category

metrics.name: fact_gap_closed_rate
metrics.plain: Share of the last audit's gaps that now have a published fix

metrics.name: fact_consistency_score
metrics.plain: Share of core facts that read identically across site, schema, feed and tracked directories
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 surfaces are tracked for a fact

metrics.name: citation_source_share
metrics.plain: Of the sources an engine cites when it answers about the brand, the share that are brand-owned
metrics.unavailable_when: the engine's answer includes no visible citations

metrics.name: wrong_fact_count_open
metrics.plain: Confirmed wrong AI-stated facts not yet corrected at any level

metrics.name: correction_landed_rate
metrics.plain: Share of corrections confirmed fixed on re-check after the set cadence
metrics.window: since correction shipped, checked at 14 and 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: no re-check has run yet for that correction

metrics.name: correction_lag_days
metrics.plain: Typical days from a wrong fact confirmed to the site-level fix published

metrics.name: citable_page_count
metrics.plain: Pages rewritten to the answer-first, atomic-fact format, out of the priority list

metrics.name: agentic_listing_accuracy
metrics.plain: Share of checked fields (price, stock, variant, delivery estimate) a shopping-agent-style query returns correctly
metrics.source: agentic listing spot-check against the live product feed

metrics.name: competitor_ai_narrative_change_count
metrics.plain: Detected changes this week in how an engine describes a named competitor
metrics.formula: count(narrative_changes) from the weekly competitor prompt slice

metrics.name: engine_coverage
metrics.plain: Which engines are currently in the monitored set
metrics.formula: list of engines with a successful run in the last 35 days
metrics.freshness_rule: flag any engine missing for 35+ days

insights.name: engine invents a fact
insights.rule: an engine's answer states a specific number or claim that does not match the facts registry
insights.sentence: {engine} told a buyer {claim}, which is not on our facts page

insights.name: recommend gap versus a competitor
insights.rule: an engine mentions the brand but recommends a named competitor for the same prompt
insights.sentence: {engine} named {competitor} instead of us for '{prompt}'

insights.name: fact drift across surfaces
insights.rule: the same fact reads with a different value on two tracked surfaces
insights.sentence: {fact} says {value_a} on the site and {value_b} on the feed

insights.name: correction did not land
insights.rule: a correction shipped N days ago and the re-check still returns the old fact
insights.sentence: {n} days after we fixed it, {engine} still says the old {fact}

insights.name: no brand-owned citation
insights.rule: an engine's answers about the brand cite zero brand-owned sources across the last audit
insights.sentence: {engine} never cites our own site when it answers about us

insights.name: shopping agent gets it wrong
insights.rule: an agentic listing spot-check returns a price or stock value that does not match the live feed
insights.sentence: {n} products show the wrong {field} to a shopping agent

insights.name: sentiment slide
insights.rule: ai_sentiment_score for an engine falls versus the prior month
insights.sentence: {engine}'s positive mentions fell {pct} points this month

insights.name: competitor narrative shift
insights.rule: a named competitor's described strengths changed between this week's and last week's prompt slice
insights.sentence: {engine} now says {competitor} is {new_claim}, it did not say that last week

insights.name: stale prompt set

not_elsewhere.claim: ties the facts page to a fixed re-check cadence that confirms a correction actually landed in the engine's answer
not_elsewhere.vs: Semrush's AI Visibility Toolkit and Ahrefs Brand Radar report current mentions, share of voice and sentiment; neither tracks whether a specific correction you shipped later landed in the engine's answer

not_elsewhere.claim: checks what a shopping agent would tell a buyer about price, stock and delivery against the brand's own live feed
not_elsewhere.vs: Profound, Otterly and the Semrush/Ahrefs AI-visibility products track how engines describe the brand in conversational answers; none of them check an agentic shopping flow against the brand's own feed

not_elsewhere.claim: scores fact consistency across site, schema, feed and directories side by side, before an engine ever asks
not_elsewhere.vs: AI-visibility tools check what an engine says; none of them cross-check the brand's own published facts against each other first

not_elsewhere.claim: sequences page rewrites by the gaps a real, frozen prompt audit found for this brand
not_elsewhere.vs: Semrush's AI Search Optimizer gives prioritized content recommendations from crawled content and general AI-visibility data, not from a frozen prompt audit tied to this brand's own confirmed gaps

not_elsewhere.claim: bundles a named competitor's changing AI narrative with their social and PR activity in one short weekly brief
not_elsewhere.vs: Ahrefs Brand Radar and Semrush track competitor share of voice as a running number; they do not produce a founder-readable weekly brief of what changed, combining PR, social and AI narrative together

founder_view_note: With no prompt runs yet, the room shows the facts page draft status and a checklist to run the first frozen prompt set, instead of a share-of-voice number. The first thing to land is ai_mention_rate once the first audit runs; fact_consistency_score needs at least 2 tracked surfaces, and agentic_listing_accuracy needs the product feed connected before it can show anything but unavailable.
